title: Mansion VPS (One Oh Four One Nine Four)
style: synthwave noir, male spoken word lead, female robotic chorus, 100 BPM, arpeggiated bass, gated reverb drums, neon-fog, IP-routing, server-room, cinematic, network-poetry, late-night-ops
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Three three six dot life, three three six dot locker
Three three six dot pics, the trinity of the rocker
Three zero one redirect to the Mansion VPS gate
One oh four one nine four one five six one oh nine the IP fate

[Pre-Chorus]
Mansion VPS destination, intentional or strayed
Confirm the routing or land the real content cascade

[Chorus]
Mansion VPS, one oh four one nine four
Three three six suite redirecting through the door
Mansion VPS, the IP holds the line
Intentional or content, the operator decides design

[Verse 2]
Livewire dot boats three zero one to somewhere unknown
RH RH MN dot IO redirect to the AI throne
Likely intentional, but the audit must confirm
Every hard skeleton accounted for the term

[Bridge]
Forty eight domains and seven hard skeletons standing
Mansion at the center of the three six demanding
Land the suite content or document the redirect
The ledger cannot tolerate the ambiguous defect

[Outro]
Mansion VPS, one oh four one nine four locked
Three three six suite waiting to be unblocked
